question: What metabolic disease is caused by a deficiency in phenylalanine hydroxylase ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Phenylalanine hydroxylase deficiency -> Accumulation of phenylalanine -> Phenylketonuria -> 95% CHAIN: Phenylalanine hydroxylase deficiency -> Impaired conversion of phenylalanine to tyrosine -> Elevated phenylalanine levels -> Phenylketonuria -> 90% CHAIN: Phenylalanine hydroxylase deficiency -> Decreased tyrosine production -> Phenylketonuria -> 95%
analysis: Phenylketonuria is a metabolic disease caused by a deficiency in phenylalanine hydroxylase, leading to the accumulation of phenylalanine in the body.
